historicalReview.note: Use the Via Sacra on the site map and monuments added in different periods to illustrate public-space orientation. Cut to the separate Pantheon example for the portico, doors and circular interior. Do not depict them as a single contiguous historical route or imply a single construction campaign.

The Pantheon gives evidence for the Roman concrete dome over the thick cylindrical rotunda. Hadrian's Villa water example is a separate complex. Place the Canopus pool outside along its own approach and do not infer that it was inside the Pantheon. The administering institute dates the villa to 118–138 CE, correcting the malformed printed range if a date is needed.

Chartres supports distinct views of nave and choir, stained glass and sculpted portals with iconographic programs. Explain how a route and images convey information in this example, with no universal layout or measured effect on visitors.

Show the qibla wall and mihrab, geometric and botanical ornament and written inscriptions as distinct roles. The current bell tower incorporates remains of the old minaret. Identify the relevant period rather than depicting the current belfry as an original working minaret.

acceptance.result: The space widens and the square landmark becomes visible. Verify the street, landmark and camera motion directly, and annotate only observed reveal frames.

authoredComparison.renderer: Unity with synchronized player and overhead views
authoredComparison.finding: 141 samples per path over equal 7-unit approaches, same eye height, destination, camera target and field of view. The frontal path sees all three door targets at the start. The oblique path sees the side first, then its first three geometrically visible door targets at 2.142857 s. At this first geometric sample the face is nearly edge-on. The oblique door's angular span first reaches the illustrative 4-degree check at 3.0 s (4.27329 degrees). The frontal path starts above that check.
authoredComparison.visualDirection: Use the two paths at equal travel distance. Bind a door mark to the surface and show it only when the actual camera output makes it readable. Use the plan view to show the occluding edge and aim point. Do not use the grazing-ray sample as a legibility or narration cue. Check actual 1080 and 375 widths before locking motion cues.
